confidence_rule.decision: Use executable v1 exact binomial order-statistic intervals, no normal approximation. Performance: one-sided 95% lower bound for median paired baseline/method wall ratio must exceed 1.05. With five timing pairs, minimum observed ratio is finite lower bound with coverage 1-2^-5=0.96875. Equivalence: two-sided family confidence >=0.95, Bonferroni over both energy metrics, per metric alpha=0.025 and per tail alpha=0.0125. Eight seed differences permit [min,max], each tail error 2^-8=0.00390625. Both bounds must lie within [-margin,+margin]. Require success separately for each method and compute budget; no claim of familywise confidence across methods or budgets. Lack of significance never establishes equivalence.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work molecular-dynamics benchmark has no scalar outcome threshold or calibrated outcome curve. Equal scientific target is complete eight-seed, 200000-step ensemble with both paired energy metrics equivalent; no early stopping or changed trajectory lengths.

paired_seed_tests.description: Pair method and sequential baseline by identical input, seed, steps and energy-query schedule. Langevin sampling and seeded velocities make outcomes stochastic despite fixed-seed reproducibility. For each metric form method-minus-baseline per-seed differences; aggregate repeated observations within seed by median before inference. Eight seeds are eight scientific units, not forty independent samples. Require both paired-median confidence intervals strictly inside their positive absolute margins. No zero-tolerance or bitwise test.

power.assumptions: Independent seed-level differences, median zero; normal paired-difference SD no larger than margin/3 for each metric. No independence between metrics assumed.
power.calculation: With eight seeds, finite two-sided exact min/max interval exists at Bonferroni per-metric alpha=0.025. Under stated normal assumption each difference lies within margin with probability erf(3/sqrt(2)); probability all eight do so is erf(3/sqrt(2))**8. Union-bound joint power for two metrics is at least 1-2*(1-erf(3/sqrt(2))**8).
power.limitation: Unconditional power cannot be established from one baseline run. Failure of assumed paired noise may produce inconclusive equivalence; do not enlarge margins or add seeds after observing candidates.
power.status: Conditional prospective power calculation; paired-difference variability not measured.

scheduling_details: For method menu order restricted to feasible entries and ascending budget, take five adjacent baseline/method timing pairs. Seeded PRNG selects arm order independently within each pair. No overlapping arms. Record all times and failures; no fastest-run selection. Scientific comparison uses all eight matched seeds at each budget.

splits.reason: No training or data fitting. Single supplied input and all eight seeds already appear in baseline evidence; no independent held-out molecular system or seeds available. Candidate results remain unseen. Claims limited to this fixed ensemble.

timing_scope.description: Match intake/EXECUTION.json ensemble scope: start immediately before replica loop/dispatch, after common PDB and system construction; end after all eight replicas, synchronized energy queries, result construction/merge and context cleanup. Include method worker launch, lazy CUDA compilation, all H2D/D2H transfers, synchronization and merge. Exclude installation, download, common input parse/system setup and final JSON serialization. Method workers launched inside timer; wait for all before stopping. Adapter synchronizes GPU at boundaries. Never sum overlapping per-replica times.

validation.gate_scripts: intake/EXECUTION.json supplies no gate script or command. Only local JSON, required-field, finite interval and evidence-consistency checks performed.
validation.seal_policy: Protocol fixed before method implementation; changing scope, budgets, seeds, sample sizes or tolerances requires new sealed run.

warmup_protocol: Zero discarded runs per arm. Fresh contexts each timing pair; context setup and lazy compilation stay timed. Preserve equivalent CUDA cache state: restore same pre-pair cache snapshot for each arm, with separate writable copies, never warm one arm using the other. No within-trajectory burn-in exclusion.
